# Topic 11 cover v01

Built-in image_gen prompt, used verbatim:

```text
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: landscape 3:2 ecology website cover illustration with genuine transparent exterior.

Primary request: Paint one rich, contiguous forest-environment vignette in a detailed natural-history watercolor and gouache style. The forest habitat is the main subject. This is an illustrative environment for ecological protection, not a field-trial map, a risk assessment, or a claim about a particular threatened species.

Scene: A layered mixed woodland patch with mature broadleaf trees, several slimmer trees, one or two restrained conifer shapes, shrubs, ferns, moss, leaf litter and a few natural stones and fallen branches. A narrow meandering earth footpath leads gently through the understory into depth. Include exactly one very small ordinary brown deer, partially concealed in the deeper vegetation, as a quiet habitat detail. Keep the animal secondary and unidentifiable as a particular threatened species; no large antler portrait or animal spotlight. No people are needed.

Style: Fine botanical observation and varied leaf shapes, textured trunks, delicate watercolor washes with gouache highlights, softly unified natural light. Muted moss, olive, sage and warm earth tones. Match the visual vocabulary of the inspected natural-history forest vignette: dense convincing foliage, depth between trees and small forest-floor details. Painterly and carefully observed, not a cartoon, CGI, toy diorama or plastic 3D render.

Composition: One connected unframed environmental vignette on a 3:2 landscape canvas. A slightly elevated natural view reveals the path and forest floor without turning it into a top-down map. Use an irregular organic silhouette that follows foliage, roots, stones and leaf litter, with small fully transparent margins on all sides. Fine edges taper into genuine alpha transparency. No geometric base, vertical soil block, rectangular landscape tile, hard oval crop, white paper background, border or backdrop halo.

Text: None.
Avoid: All writing, labels, numbers, arrows, UI, grids, property boundaries, risk zones, surveillance graphics, guns, traps, wire snares, dead animals, threatening predators, uniform rows of tree icons or disconnected object collages.
Output: One PNG with true transparency outside the painted forest vignette; preserve fine natural edge detail.
```
